title: Scope readiness admission to the diagnostic rather than the entire settings save
outcome: Final Claude7093 Low, retained after adjudication. src/api.rs PATCH acquires a readiness permit for enabled requests and retains it over all patch_project_engram_settings work, including teardown/revocation/persistence. Slow post-probe work can occupy the two-slot readiness pool and 429 another Verify; pure_authority_clear also acquires despite skipping readiness. Move admission to the actual probe boundary while retaining fail-fast concurrency and holding permits until blocking diagnostics really stop. Preserve unconditional disable escape. Add tests for non-probe save work and authority-clear bypass.
